name: app.risingsign/rising-sign
title: RisingSign — Rising, Sun & Moon Sign Calculator
description: Calculate Rising (Ascendant), Sun, and Moon signs with exact zodiac degrees and historical DST.

tools.name: calculate_rising_sign
tools.description: Calculate the exact Rising (Ascendant) sign, zodiac degree, Midheaven (MC), chart ruler, and house system for a birth date, local time, geographic coordinates (latitude/longitude), and IANA time zone using astronomical ephemeris math and historical DST.

date.description: Birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format (1900-01-01 to 2100-12-31), e.g. '1990-04-03'.

time.description: Local birth time in 24-hour HH:MM format, e.g. '14:30'.

latitude.description: Birthplace latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90, north positive), e.g. 40.7128 for New York.

longitude.description: Birthplace longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180, east positive), e.g. -74.006 for New York.

timezone.description: IANA time zone identifier for the birthplace, e.g. 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London', or 'UTC'.

houseSystem.description: House system to use ('placidus' or 'whole-sign'). Defaults to 'placidus' (falls back to 'whole-sign' at extreme polar latitudes).

tools.name: calculate_big_three
tools.description: Calculate Sun, Moon, and Rising (Ascendant) signs with exact zodiac degrees, elements, modalities, house placements, and personal planet positions for a birth date, optional local time, geographic coordinates, and IANA time zone. When time is omitted, returns same-day possible Sun/Moon signs and full-day Rising sign time windows.

date.description: Birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format (1900-01-01 to 2100-12-31), e.g. '1990-04-03'.

time.description: Optional local birth time in 24-hour HH:MM format, e.g. '14:30'. Omit if birth time is unknown.

latitude.description: Birthplace latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90, north positive), e.g. 40.7128 for New York.

longitude.description: Birthplace longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180, east positive), e.g. -74.006 for New York.

timezone.description: IANA time zone identifier for the birthplace, e.g. 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London', or 'UTC'.

houseSystem.description: House system to use ('placidus' or 'whole-sign'). Defaults to 'placidus'.
